title: 12 遇袭13 自救看俺们的防贼必杀技
content_zh:
庶女的生存法则
最终，还是如情以两票胜一票的优势，夺得压倒性的胜利，如晴兴高采列地指挥着下头的小厮把鞭炮抬到后山上一处空地上，尽情地疯狂，并且还对着远方的高山狂吼，这该死的古代，这该死的一夫多妾制，这该死的等及森严的鬼地方，还有这该死的不是女人呆的破地方，还有那些时常找她麻烦的混蛋王八蛋臭鸡蛋……直到月亮升到头顶，人也吼得筋皮力竭，这才余犹未尽地回到将军府。
为替傅将军接风洗尘，知义当晚便赴总督衙门，估计要捱到很晚才能回来。如情便让厨房不再准备知义那份，一个人在琳琅园用了晚膳，无所是事，如情便与几个丫头一起玩起了叶子牌，如情手气很好，一口气赢了好些碎银铜板，乐得像什么似的。赢了钱的如情，准备明日领丫头们外出好好玩上一天，顺便透透气。
第二日，如情果然说到做到，换了外出的衣裳，领了沉香，玲珑，玉琴，三个丫头一并坐了马车，本来只打算去逛逛大街，在附近有名的景点游玩一番。
只不过今天运气不大好，在一处小山坳处，居然见到前方有刀剑击杀声，一方是统一玄黑色劲装武士，另一边是一群穿着动物皮，身形高大穿着简陋的人，护卫如情的七品校蔚刘大强定眼一瞧，忽然失声尖叫：“不好，是靼鞑。”
如情刚开始还没有明白过来靼鞑是什么东东，又听见刘大强又嘶声尖叫：“糟了，居然是靖王爷。”
如情一听李骁的名字下意识地脑袋一缩，哀声又叹气，更别提有多别扭，连忙探出窗外，果然，隔得较远，在一群混战中的人里，也能轻易识别出李骁来，不是此人太英俊，气质过于独特，而是这家伙穿的够华丽，够招摇，被靼鞑给当成了大肥羊打劫了。
“刘大哥，看样子，好像李骁这边已处于弱势呀，不大妙呀。”
沉香忙道：“姑娘，还是别管了，咱们还是快回去吧，迟了可就无法脱身了。”
如睛点头，李骁这边只有二十余人，但靼鞑却有上百余人，虽然李骁功夫不错，这些护卫也是以一挡十的好手，但架不住人家的轮番上攻，好些身上都已挂彩。靼鞑人凶残成性那可是名不虚传的，估计若无援兵，李骁今天已是凶多吉少了。
刘大强神色也略有焦急，见李骁处于下风，连忙咬牙对近身的士兵道：“你快去通知附近的守军，就说靼鞑入侵，靖王被围，火速派人来营救。”然后又对如情道：“姑娘，此地不宜久留，卑职先护送您去安全的地方。”
如情点头，心神不宁地坐回了马车，马车掉了头，正准备朝安全的地方驶去。可惜却迟了一步，那边围攻李骁的靼鞑首领也发现了如情这一行人马。
刘大强见状，暗叫不妙，厉声命令车夫驾车，他们垫后。
车夫抹了额上的汗水，马鞭甩在马屁股身上，急忙往回奔去。刘大强一边勒马前行，一边对车内的如情解释：“姑娘，这是蒙古人，烧杀抢掠，无恶不作。只是不知怎的，居然给跑到这里来了。”
如情也偶然听说过蒙古人生性残暴，杀人如麻，听刘大强这么一说，也吓得面无人色，赶紧缩回车里，只期盼着快点进入城里。
可惜，天不随愿，那群靼鞑人一见如情的马车及刘大强等人，如同猫儿见着了老鼠，那个兴奋，嗷嗷地叫着朝如情这边冲来。
刘大强脸色倏变，嘶声吩咐车夫继续驾马，并让如情保重，躲在车内，不许冒出头来。然后从身后取了箭，狠狠往马屁股上一插，马儿吃痛，狂嘶一声继续跑得飞快。可惜，如情这马儿跑得快是快，但却敌不过靼鞑人**的马，很快，便追上了刘大强他们。刘大强瞧着靼鞑三十来铁骑，又瞧着已方十数名护卫，及如情车子里的一干弱质女流，咬牙吩咐让几名将士护卫如情，而他则领着大部份人，掉转马儿，往靼鞑冲去。
刘大强身形高大，力大如虎，手握两根大棒槌，气势如虹地冲进了靼鞑的队伍，很快就有两名靼鞑放翻下了马，其余的将士也跟着加入了战斗，缓解了靼鞑人的进攻，眼见如情的马车跑远了，刘大强稍松了口气，继续狂吼一声轮着大棒槌一番不要命的撕杀。
如情从车箱里探出头来，心里紧张万分，刘大强这是要拿已方十余人与对方数十铁骑死拼了，心里又悔又恨，如果她不出府，就什么事都不会发生了。
身后响来乒乓作响的刀剑撞击声，及刀剑刺入身体里的惨叫，再来还有箭矢射在车门上发出的沉闷声响，沉香玲珑及玉琴吓得面无人色，抱着如情尖叫不已。如情也吓得说不出话来，心想今天肯定完了，完了，被这群人抓到，她还有活路么？

草源上从来都缺少女人，父亲死后，老婆留下给儿子享用，没儿子留给弟弟，没弟弟给侄子……反正循环使用，五十岁的老妪再给二十来岁的小伙子也是常有的事，女人对于蒙古人来说，一是为了泄欲，二是为了传宗接代。这群鞑靼人不知用什么方式进入大同地界，一是为了抢掠，顺便就是找关内女人发泄了，若是被他们抓到手头，铁定是先歼后杀，绝无第二条活路。所以如情骇得实在没法，只能祀悼援兵快来……
陡地，车窗被人击破，数个靼鞑人已带着一副奸笑往如情的马车追来，已有两个护卫中箭牺牲，车夫也被砍伤，却强撑着驾马，正是危急时分，又是一阵震耳欲聋的尖叫声，如情强睁着双眼，外头传来一阵大笑声：“想不到这里还有几个娇滴滴的小娘子，哈哈，老子赚到了呀。”
如情闭眼，随手抓了个不知名的物品就丢了出去，也不知打中没，便听到一个流里流气地声音：“哟，还挺泼辣的，老子喜欢。”紧接着，又有刀砍在车厢上的沉闷震动感，车里几个姑娘更是吓得放声尖叫，忽然间，外头响来一个闷哼，车夫被砍，骨碌碌从车上滚了下去，马儿失去了控制，又受了刺激，更是漫无目的地疯跑。
如情吓得面色煞白，紧紧抓着车子里的抚手，马儿跑得飞快，轻易停不下来了，后边又有靼鞑追赶，身下马车抖动如筛子，几乎快把腰给折断，不知到了哪，但有一点值得肯定，马儿应该不是朝城里驶去，而是驶在一条坑洼不平又崎岖的山路上，因为，车厢数度被外头的树枝挂住，车上的帷幔被枝杈挂住，车顶已被掀翻来，从头顶望去，全是一片紧密的树林。
content_en:
The survival rules of a concubine
In the end, Ruqing won an overwhelming victory with two votes to one. Ruqing happily directed the servants below to carry the firecrackers to an open space on the back mountain. They went crazy as much as they wanted and yelled at the mountains in the distance. This damn ancient time, this damn ancient time. The system of multiple concubines, this damned place with strict waiting times, this damned place where women don’t live, and those bastards and rotten eggs who always make trouble for her... It wasn’t until the moon rose above her head that she roared until she was exhausted, and then she returned to the General’s Mansion without finishing.
In order to take care of General Fu, Zhiyi went to the governor's office that night, and he probably wouldn't be back until very late. Ruqing stopped preparing Zhiyi's share in the kitchen and had dinner alone in Linlang Garden with nothing to do. Ruqing played leaf cards with a few girls. Ruqing was very lucky and won many broken silver coins in one go. She seemed happy. Ruqing, who won the money, is going to take the girls out tomorrow to have a fun day and get some fresh air.
On the second day, Ruqing kept her promise. She changed her clothes for going out and took agarwood, Linglong and Yuqin. The three girls got into the carriage together. Originally they only planned to go shopping on the street and visit famous scenic spots nearby.
But I was not very lucky today. At a small mountain pass, I actually saw the sound of swords and swords in front of me. On one side were warriors in uniform dark black uniforms, and on the other side were a group of tall and poorly dressed people wearing animal skins. Liu Daqiang, the guard of the seventh-grade school who was affectionate, took a closer look and suddenly screamed: "No, it's a Tartar."
Ruqing didn't understand what Tatar was at first, but then she heard Liu Daqiang scream again: "Oh no, it's Prince Jing."
When Ruqing heard Li Xiao's name, she subconsciously shrank her head, whined and sighed, not to mention how awkward it was, and quickly leaned out the window. Sure enough, from a distance, she could easily identify Li Xiao among a group of people in the melee. It wasn't that this man was too handsome or his temperament was too unique, but that this guy was dressed gorgeously and ostentatiously enough, and was robbed by the Tatars as a big fat sheep.
"Brother Liu, it looks like Li Xiao is already at a disadvantage, which is not good."
Chen Xiang hurriedly said: "Girl, it's better not to worry about it. Let's go back quickly. If it's too late, we won't be able to escape."
Ru Jing nodded. There were only about twenty people on Li Xiao's side, but there were more than a hundred people in Tartar. Although Li Xiao was good at martial arts and these guards were good at blocking ten, they could not withstand the attacks from others, and many of them were already injured. The Tartars are well-deserved for their ferocious nature. It is estimated that without reinforcements, Li Xiao would have been in trouble today.
Liu Daqiang also looked a little anxious. Seeing that Li Xiao was at a disadvantage, he quickly gritted his teeth and said to the nearby soldiers: "Go and inform the nearby defenders that the Tartars have invaded and Prince Jing is surrounded. Send people to rescue you quickly." Then he said to Ruqing: "Girl, it is not suitable to stay here for a long time. I humbly escort you to a safe place first."
Ruqing nodded and sat back in the carriage uneasily. The carriage turned around and was about to drive to a safe place. Unfortunately, it was a step too late. The Tatar leader who besieged Li Xiao over there also discovered Ruqing's group.
When Liu Daqiang saw this, he secretly screamed that something was wrong, and sternly ordered the driver to drive and they should stay behind.
The coachman wiped the sweat from his forehead, swung his riding crop on the horse's butt, and hurried back. As Liu Daqiang reined in his horse and drove forward, he explained to Ruqing in the car: "Girl, these are Mongolians. They burn, kill and loot. They do all kinds of evil. But somehow they ended up here."
Ruqing also heard by chance that the Mongols were cruel and murderous. When Liu Daqiang said this, she was so frightened that she turned pale and hurriedly retreated into the car, hoping to enter the city quickly.
Unfortunately, God did not have his wish. The group of Tatars fell in love with the carriage and Liu Daqiang and others at first sight, just like a cat seeing a mouse, the one was excited and howled.Rushing towards Ruqing.
Liu Daqiang's expression suddenly changed, and he hissed at the coachman to continue driving, and told Ruqing to take care and hide in the car, not to show up. Then he took the arrow from behind and thrust it hard into the horse's butt. The horse felt pain, neighed wildly and continued to run fast. Unfortunately, Ruqing's horse was fast, but it was no match for the Tatar horse. Soon, it caught up with Liu Daqiang and the others. Liu Daqiang looked at the thirty or so Tartar cavalry, and at the dozen or so guards on his side, as well as the weak women in Ruqing's car. He gritted his teeth and ordered a few soldiers to escort Ruqing, while he led most of the people, turned their horses, and rushed towards the Tartars.
Liu Daqiang was tall and as strong as a tiger. He held two big clubs in his hands and rushed into the Tartar team with great momentum. Soon, two Tartars fell off their horses. The rest of the soldiers also joined the battle, mitigating the Tartar attack. Seeing Ruqing's carriage running away, Liu Daqiang breathed a sigh of relief and continued to roar and use the big clubs to kill them desperately.
Ruqing poked her head out of the carriage, feeling extremely nervous. Liu Daqiang was going to fight to the death with more than a dozen of his own people and dozens of cavalry from the other side. He felt regret and hatred in his heart. If she had not left the house, nothing would have happened.
There was the sound of swords clashing behind them, and the screams of swords piercing their bodies, and then there was the dull sound of arrows hitting the car door. Chenxiang Linglong and Yuqin were so frightened that their faces turned pale, and they hugged Ruqing and screamed. Ruqing was also so frightened that she couldn't speak. She thought that today was definitely over. It was over. If she was caught by this group of people, would she still have a chance to survive?
There has always been a shortage of women in the grassland. After the father died, the wife was left for his son to enjoy, and if there was no son, he would leave it to his younger brother, and if there was no younger brother, he would leave it to his nephew... Anyway, it is recycled. It is common for a fifty-year-old woman to give it to a twenty-year-old young man. For the Mongolians, women are used to vent their sexual desires and to carry on the family line. This group of Tatars entered the territory of Datong through unknown means. Firstly, they wanted to rob, and by the way, they wanted to vent their anger on the women in the pass. If they were caught, they would definitely annihilate them first and then kill them. There would be no second way to survive. So Ruqing was so horrified that she had no choice but to offer condolences and help the reinforcements come quickly...
On the steep slope, the window was broken, and several Tatars were chasing Ruqing's carriage with cunning smiles. Two guards had been killed by arrows, and the coachman was also slashed, but he forced himself to drive the horse. At the critical moment, there was another deafening scream. Ruqingqiang opened his eyes, and there was a burst of laughter from outside: "I didn't expect there are some pretty little ladies here, haha, I made a profit."
Ruqing closed her eyes, grabbed an unknown object and threw it out. She didn't know whether it was hit or not, but she heard a sly voice: "Hey, it's quite aggressive, I like it." Then, there was the dull sound of a knife slashing on the carriage. Several girls in the car were so frightened that they screamed loudly due to the vibration. Suddenly, there was a muffled groan outside. The driver was slashed and Gululu rolled off the car. The horse lost control and was stimulated again, running wildly and aimlessly.
Ruqing's face turned pale with fright, and she clutched the hand in the carriage tightly. The horse ran so fast that it could not stop easily. There were Tatars chasing after it. The carriage beneath her was shaking like a sieve, and her waist was almost broken. She didn't know where she was, but one thing is worth affirming, the horse It was probably not driving towards the city, but driving on a bumpy and bumpy mountain road, because the carriage was caught on the branches outside several times, the curtains on the car were caught on the branches, and the roof of the car had been flipped up. Looking from above, it was all a dense forest.
